components.text: The line ran even. The shaft did not sing. Stress sat under the cap. Then the load vanished and the source kept turning.※ A cog on the bench is spinning by itself. I did not touch it. Something behind the workshop wall is counting with me — no steps, no shadow on the floor.
I write while the ink still obeys a ruler. No digit after the dash: it is already gone. The leaf tears as if it was pulled from the inside, not the edge.
